items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: with John Robichaud's band they had... old man Charlie McCurdy. He was playing clarinet and sax.

ctx.x: Yeah. Who was in the band when you were there?

Well, with John Robichaud's band they had Willie Paggio. He was playing trumpet. Harrison Bones was playing trombone. Moistad Garner was playing piano. Moistad Garner was playing piano. Old Man Kimball, Kimball's daddy, was playing bass. Willie San Diego was playing banjo. Professor Robichaud was playing violin. And I was playing drums. Clarinet? Did you name him a clarinet? I'm trying to remember. Clarinet? Well, we had old man Charlie McCurdy. He was playing clarinet and sax. What's sax?
